name: Vasilisa Premudraja
source:
Vasilisa the Wise is a visual novel based on the famous Russian fairy tale "The Frog Princess". However, unlike the well-known fairy tale, in this game there are several scenarios, depending on the actions of the player. For example, in the famous fairy tale, the hero burns the skin of the frog. Here he has a choice - to burn the skin or not.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2460060/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《智者瓦西里莎》是一部根据俄罗斯著名童话《青蛙公主》改编的视觉小说。然而，与众所周知的童话故事不同的是，这款游戏有多种场景，具体取决于玩家的行动。例如，在著名的童话故事中，英雄烧毁了青蛙的皮肤。在这里他有一个选择——是否烧伤皮肤。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2460060/]Steam[/url]]
